title: Tensor products of reduced algebras over a perfect field are reduced
statement: Let $k$ be a perfect field (of characteristic $0$, or of characteristic $p>0$ with $x\mapsto x^p$ surjective on $k$) and let $R$, $S$ be reduced $k$-algebras (commutative rings with a ring map from $k$ [def-pc-field-extension] and with no nonzero nilpotent elements). Then $R\otimes_kS$ is reduced.
